_comment: PLACEHOLDER — this does not verify anything yet.
Digital Asset Links is what removes the browser URL bar from the
installed Android app. Replace the sha256_cert_fingerprints entry below
with the fingerprint of the key that actually signed the APK:
Play builds: Play Console > your app > Setup > App integrity >
App signing key certificate > SHA-256. Use THAT, not the upload key.
Using the upload key is the classic reason the URL bar appears only
on the build that came from Play.
(note the GitHub Actions runner generates a fresh debug key per run,
so a CI debug build's fingerprint is not stable and cannot be pinned
here — that is why debug builds show the URL bar.)
This file is served at /.well-known/assetlinks.json by app.py.
Remove this _comment key once the fingerprint is real.
